# WA Validator — WhatsApp Bulk Checker API

> Check up to 100 phone numbers for WhatsApp in one synchronous request. 1 credit per number.

## Endpoint
POST https://wavalidator.com/api/v1/bulk-check/
Headers: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY (or apikey: YOUR_API_KEY) ; Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"numbers": ["14155551234", "14155550000", "447911123456"]}

## Response
{"checked":3,"invalid":0,"total":3,"credits_used":3,"credits_remaining":97,
 "results":[{"number":"14155551234","exists":true,"source":"live","status":"valid"}, ...]}
results[].status: "valid" = has WhatsApp; "invalid" = no WhatsApp or malformed; "error" = not completed, retry, not charged.
results[].source: "live", a cache source, or "format_check" (rejected before the live check, still charged).
If credits run out mid-batch the rest is skipped: compare results length with total.

## Number format
Country code + national number, digits only, 7-15 digits. "+", spaces and "-" are stripped.

## Errors
400 bad JSON / numbers not a non-empty array / more than 100; 401 bad key; 402 no credits;
429 {"status":"limit","window":"minute|hour|day","retry_after":N} plus Retry-After header.

## Batching
For lists over 100, split into chunks of 100 and send sequentially, sleeping retry_after on 429.
